verdict.reasoning: The 300 dpi render of p658 is blank apart from scan specks and the licence stamp, and p659 prints the SECTION XIV title, so the facts in the claim are accurate. But the first heading is not misplaced content. specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md follows the same pattern at every section break that starts after a blank verso: a blank-page comment followed by a bare '# SECTION <n>: <title>' anchor, then the printed, underlined title on the next page. It appears for SECTION II, VII, IX, X, XI, XII, XIV, XVII and AMENDMENT 1 (grep 'This page is blank'). It is a document-structure anchor, which is scaffolding. The transcription loses or changes no printed text, and the meaning is unchanged. The printed title is transcribed faithfully on p659. If the project wants that convention removed, it should be one decision applied to all nine places, not a defect on p658 alone.
